category_title: Underprepared writers who utilize non-standard technology like cell phones for long-form academic papers
scenario_title: Reluctance to engage in peer-review workshops
minimal_context: The student is sitting in a small group classroom setting to critique three separate drafts of their peers' research papers.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please exchange the three separate drafts of your research papers with your small group and begin the peer-review critique.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I always thought that peer review was a big waste of time because only the teacher’s opinion matters anyway.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try to read through their drafts and write down what you think.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm just going to wait for your feedback. Like I said, only the teacher's opinion matters for my grade.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is important to work with your group. Please share your thoughts with them.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not doing it. It's an everyone-for-him-or-herself culture. When you’re drowning, the last person you think to turn to is someone else who doesn’t know how to swim.
